messages:
incident-bot: Paging on-call: Elevated 5xx and gateway errors detected for inference-gateway (region: eu-west-1). Spike started ~02:10 UTC, aggregated 5xx rate 18% across frontends. Paging severity: P1. See /incidents/5240007777.
jamie (oncall): on it, joining call now. can someone post quick scope (customer impact)? :rotating_light:
kevin (support): seeing multiple customer-reported failures — a couple of high-traffic customers reporting timeouts then 502s. Support ticket numbers: #4729, #4730.
jamie (oncall): thanks. sara, any dashboards?
sara (sre): grabbing dashboards. summary: backend (inference pool) healthy, but frontend envoy proxies show elevated 5xx/502 and increased upstream reset errors. p95 latency between proxy and pool is normal. Error pattern looks like immediate 5xx from proxy after upstream connect failures.
sara (sre): timeline: 02:09 UTC error increase on edge proxies, 02:12 repeat spikes across many LB shards. concurrent connection counts on LB are fine.
mike (runtime-eng): hypothesis: retry/circuit settings at LB -> envoy route layer might be amplifying backpressure; if retries cascade to overloaded shards we'll see 5xx spike. can someone fetch the active route config?
nina (platform): pulling envoy config from a few affected hosts now (host ids: eu-edge-12/13/14). pasting trimmed snippet:
```yaml
route_config:
  name: inference_frontend
  virtual_hosts:
  - name: svc-inference
    routes:
    - match: /v1/generate
      route:
        cluster: inference-pool
        retry_policy:
          retry_on: 5xx,connect,refused-stream
          num_retries: 3
        max_stream_duration: 0s
        request_timeout: 15s
    - match: /v1/embeddings
      route: { cluster: inference-pool-emb }
    retry_budget: { budget_percent: 20, min_retry_concurrency: 10 }
  circuit_breakers:
    thresholds:
      max_connections: 32000
      max_pending_requests: 200
      max_requests: 1000
      max_retries: 3
```
sara (sre): thanks. seeing a lot of upstream connection resets and occasional 'no healthy upstream' from envoy metrics. retry_budget/min_retry_concurrency looks high relative to active shards — potential storm when upstream transient fail occurs.
jamie (oncall): immediate mitigation options?
mike (runtime-eng): 1) disable retries for /v1/generate to prevent amplification 2) lower min_retry_concurrency/budget_percent 3) temporarily route a portion of traffic to a fallback pool (older model instances) 4) bump circuit breaker thresholds? actually lowering concurrency thresholds may help fail fast.
sara (sre): agree. safest fastest: toggle retry_policy.num_retries -> 0 for /v1/generate on edge-default route. that's a hot-reload on config and low risk. I'll prepare the change.
nina (platform): applying patch to envoy config on a single canary host (eu-edge-12) now. will watch keys.
jamie (oncall): thx. update when canary results in 5m window.
(120s later)
sara (sre): canary done: disabled retries on eu-edge-12. 5xx drop from 18% to 6% on that host within 90s.
jamie (oncall): good sign. roll to remaining edges gradually. nina, please patch eu-edge-13/14/15 next.
nina (platform): rolling change across affected shard set now with 20s stagger.
(3m later)
sara (sre): aggregate 5xx dropped from 18% -> 4.2% across region. customer errors decreasing; open tickets #4729/#4730 report partial recovery.
kevin (support): customers seeing improvement, one customer confirms back to normal for most requests. keeping tickets updated. :thumbsup:
olivia (pm): any known root cause? rolling fixes okay but we need a postmortem.
mike (runtime-eng): preliminary root cause: retry budget + num_retries combined with transient upstream connect errors caused retry amplification. envoy retried on 5xx/connect quickly and retried across multiple shards due to LB routing, causing spikes and triggering secondary errors. config permitted too many concurrent retries (min_retry_concurrency=10) and budget_percent=20 which is aggressive for this pool's traffic pattern.
sara (sre): also noticed that some circuit_breaker settings were permissive for connections but tight for requests, causing early overload signals in weird sequencing. will capture metrics.
jamie (oncall): handoff: I'll stay on for next 45 mins to ensure stable. oncall shift at 03:00 UTC? if it overlaps, I'll handoff to sara.
sara (sre): I'll take over after jamie. will gather config diffs and timeline for postmortem.
mike (runtime-eng): follow-ups to include: 1) tighten retry_budget defaults globally 2) change default num_retries for heavy endpoints to 0/1 3) add a canary guard that auto-disables retries if upstream error rate spikes 4) run a chaos job to validate retry amplification scenarios.
nina (platform): I'll open an infra ticket to add a runtime guard and to push safe defaults to the bootstrap config.
olivia (pm): notify enterprise customers with incident status update. I'll draft message with kevin.
kevin (support): doing that now. posting to status page: "Partial outage for inference requests in eu-west-1; mitigation applied, service recovering".
sara (sre): logging final seconds: will collect envoy admin dumps (clusters/routes/stats) and attach to incident doc. moving thread to monitoring for 30m.
jamie (oncall): handing off to sara for post-incident work. thank you everyone. :heart:
incident-bot: Incident acknowledged: status=mitigated; severity downgraded to P2. Reference: /incidents/5240007777/notes
